summary: Iteration 2 backend regression for Myra-project. Refreshed pytest suite to cover new 256-code ESV seed, stricter [1-4] digit validation, rich a/p/h/c/title/severity/profile contract, and a real Gemini 3.1-pro round-trip exercising the Myra-modell system prompt + 70k-token knowledge base. 29/29 tests passed in ~15s.

minor.issue: Stale comment block inside the 'if r.status_code != 200' branch is misleading — comment describes a fallback path but code unconditionally raises 401. Cosmetic only, carried over from iter 1.
Out-of-range digit (e.g. 5678, 9999) and digit-0 (0000) all return 400 with the same Hungarian message — correct per spec, but consider distinct messages for length vs. range to aid the frontend UX.
/app/memory/test_credentials.md still lists the OLD demo codes (1234/5678/9012/4321). Update to reflect the new 256-code seed (e.g. document 2334 / 2222 as canonical test codes).

action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to remove the obsolete 1234/5678/9012/4321 demo table and document the new 256-code seed (point at 2334, 2222 as canonical test codes).
(Optional) Tidy stale comment block inside /api/auth/session error branch (cosmetic).
(Optional) Differentiate 400 messages between 'length != 4' and 'digit out of 1..4' for cleaner UX.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~486 lines, single-file is still acceptable. Myra system prompt + KB injection is clean and isolated in _build_system_prompt().
Validation runs in correct order: length → digit-range → DB lookup, so 9999/5678 short-circuit at 400 without hitting Mongo. Good.
256-code seed loaded from ODS via scripts/seed_codes.py; runtime startup() no longer seeds demo codes — matches PRD.
KB is read once at import (~70k tokens) and concatenated into every system prompt. Token cost per chat call is high but is the intended design. Consider caching/compression if scale grows.
ObjectId is correctly excluded with {'_id': 0} projections across all reads.
Bearer auth + TTL index on user_sessions.expires_at remain correct.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY required in /api/chat/send with explicit 500 if missing — clear failure mode.
Frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Expo public convention); used correctly by tests.
seed_data_creation: Per-test ephemeral users + sessions injected directly into MongoDB (users, user_sessions, chat_messages) with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up in fixture teardown. The 256 state_codes were pre-seeded by scripts/seed_codes.py; admin CRUD test temporarily mutates code '1111' and restores the original document in a finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run regression with: `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest . -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Tests bypass Emergent OAuth by inserting users + user_sessions docs into Mongo. TestChat::test_chat_real_gemini_and_history makes a REAL Gemini 3.1-pro call (~10s, costs key quota) and asserts the Myra prompt is in effect (no 'ESV'/'P-érték'/code echo, Hungarian reply). Canonical test codes: 2334 (CLINICAL), 2222 (ELEVATED). Old demo codes 5678/9012 are NO LONGER valid (digit out of 1..4). 1234 and 4321 remain in the 256 seed but are no longer special.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All assertions for the new 256-code seed, stricter validation, rich profile contract, Myra system-prompt behaviour, chat history, reset, and admin smoke pass.
